name: Ruth Mountain
range: North Cascades National Park · Mt. Baker Wilderness
blurb: A snow dome with a front-row view of Shuksan's north side, and a classic first glacier climb.
permit: Northwest Forest Pass at the Hannegan trailhead. Hannegan Camp is in the Mt. Baker Wilderness; overnight stays inside the national park need a park permit. Hannegan Pass Road (FR 32) is rough: check its status before you drive.

routes.name: Ruth Glacier
routes.summary: The Hannegan Pass trail up Ruth Creek, a climbers path south along the ridge from the pass, then a gentle glacier to an exposed summit crest.
skills: Balance on an exposed snow crest

line.source: Placed by hand on terrain data and published route descriptions; not surveyed

waypoints.name: Hannegan Camp
waypoints.note: Forest camp just below the pass, in the Mt. Baker Wilderness.

sections.note: Hannegan Pass trail up the Ruth Creek valley. Avalanche paths cross it early in the season.
Climbers path south along the ridge to the edge of the glacier. Early in summer you can stay on snow over the ridge high point.
Gentle glacier with a few crevasses by late summer, then an exposed crest to the top.

pois.name: Shuksan view
pois.note: Straight across the Nooksack Cirque to Shuksan's north face.
